item.title: One flipped equation, and the Universe Eats Itself
item.description: What happens when a highly cited scientific paper accidentally rewrites the laws of physics? Discover how a tiny, invisible error slipped past peer review to create a universe that destroys itself - and the ’third eye’ built to hunt these threats down.
